title: Kohler Tempered K-T22032-4-2MB Transfer Valve Trim, Vibrant Brushed Moderne Brass

comparisons.notes: Same model K-T22032-4-2MB, Vibrant Brushed Moderne Brass finish

amazon_match_notes: Woot offer data ASIN; Amazon listing is Kohler K-T22032-4-2MB, same model
writeup: Kohler's Tempered transfer valve trim in Vibrant Brushed Moderne Brass, model K-T22032-4-2MB, is $101.99 at Woot. Bath Barn lists the same trim at $204.41, about half off. It's the faceplate and lever handle for a MasterShower 2- or 3-way transfer or diverter valve, sold separately.
